item.title: Sign in with Google for React Native
item.content:encoded: Modern Sign in with Google for React Native using Android's Credential Manager, the GoogleSignIn-iOS SDK, and a first-party Expo config plugin. TypeScript-first.

item.title: What founders told us about working with AI tools for startups
item.content:encoded: AI can help you ship a prototype in a weekend, but it won't tell you if you're building the right thing. We talked to founders who use AI tools every day to find out where it actually helps, and where it can quietly hurt you.
